symptom: a freshly built Forms$TabPage with no widgets (also DivContainer, GroupBox, LayoutGridColumn, ScrollContainerRegion, NavigationListItem) was written with no Widgets key at all, where Studio Pro stores Widgets: [2]
cause: the codec's new-element path emits only dirty properties; an untouched empty PartList is never dirty, so it was omitted. Only Forms$DataView had a per-type TypeDefaults MandatoryListMarkers entry for Widgets
file: modelsdk/codec/defaults.go + encoder.go (RegisterMandatoryPropertyList: a property-keyed marker that is also emitted empty on a new element); mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_list_markers.go registers it for the 15 Widgets owners
insight: Sweep presence, not just values: a scan of every $Type with a Widgets key in TestApp + PedApp found it absent 0 times (TabPage 89/89, 20 empty; LayoutGridColumn 732/732; DivContainer 838/838; WidgetValue 20,775/20,775), so the list is mandatory per owner. Key it on owner+property in the codec rather than adding per-type RegisterTypeDefaults entries, which replace (not merge) an existing registration and clobbered defaults once already (#812). The control is a type Studio Pro never stores the key on (TabControl, ScrollContainer) - it must not gain one.
